name: Taghazout
blurb: Conversation about Taghazout is up 189% on its six-month baseline, driven by travellers describing it as a calmer alternative to nearby hotspots. Most posts mention beaches, value and the shoulder season.

positive: Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
negative: Some report crowding at peak times
Cheap accommodation getting harder to find

quotes.text: Second time here and it still feels underrated.
The food alone would be worth the trip.
Spent a week here working remotely, wifi was fine everywhere.
